Uyghurs.fact: In general, Muslims in the southern region, Kashgar in particular, are more conservative. While the vast majority of Uyghur Muslims had been Sunni, there had been some Shia Uyghurs, mostly Ismaili with a Twelver minority.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: For example, women wearing the veil (a piece of cloth covering the head completely) are more common in _____ than some other cities
Uyghurs.fact: In general, Muslims in the southern region, Kashgar in particular, are more conservative. For example, women wearing the veil (a piece of cloth covering the head completely) are more common in Kashgar than some other cities.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The veil, however, has been banned in cities such as Ürümqi since _____ after it became more popular there
Uyghurs.fact: The veil, however, has been banned in cities such as Ürümqi since 2014 after it became more popular there.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A minority of _____ were Twelver
Uyghurs.fact: A minority of Uyghur Shias were Twelver.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: During the _____ and Maoist eras in China, Shia Muslims were marginalized both nationally by the Han Chinese authorities, and regionally by Sunni Uyghur religious elites
Uyghurs.fact: During the Republican and Maoist eras in China, Shia Muslims were marginalized both nationally by the Han Chinese authorities, and regionally by Sunni Uyghur religious elites.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: According to a _____ Australian Strategic Policy Institute report, Chinese authorities since 2017 have destroyed or damaged 16,000 mosques in Xinjiang
Uyghurs.fact: According to a 2020 Australian Strategic Policy Institute report, Chinese authorities since 2017 have destroyed or damaged 16,000 mosques in Xinjiang.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: According to a 2020 _____ report, Chinese authorities since 2017 have destroyed or damaged 16,000 mosques in Xinjiang
Uyghurs.fact: According to a 2020 Australian Strategic Policy Institute report, Chinese authorities since 2017 have destroyed or damaged 16,000 mosques in Xinjiang.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: These Salafis tended to demonstrate pan-_____ and abandoned nationalism in favor of a caliphate to rule Xinjiang in the event of independence from China
Uyghurs.fact: These Salafis tended to demonstrate pan-Islamism and abandoned nationalism in favor of a caliphate to rule Xinjiang in the event of independence from China.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: He also noted that the people of _____ did not know Turkic well and had their own language and script (Khotanese)
Uyghurs.fact: He also noted that the people of Khotan did not know Turkic well and had their own language and script (Khotanese).

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Writers of the _____ period, Al-Kashgari and Yusuf Balasagun, referred to their Turkic language as Khāqāniyya (meaning royal) or the "language of Kashgar" or simply Turkic
Uyghurs.fact: Writers of the Karakhanid period, Al-Kashgari and Yusuf Balasagun, referred to their Turkic language as Khāqāniyya (meaning royal) or the "language of Kashgar" or simply Turkic.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The modern _____ language is classified under the Karluk branch of the Turkic language family
Uyghurs.fact: In the 11th century, Mahmud al-Kashgari noted that the Uyghurs (of Qocho) spoke a pure Turkic language, but they also still spoke another language among themselves and had two different scripts. The modern Uyghur language is classified under the Karluk branch of the Turkic language family.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: It is closely related to Äynu, Lop, _____ and Chagatay (the East Karluk languages) and slightly less closely to Uzbek (which is West Karluk)
Uyghurs.fact: It is closely related to Äynu, Lop, Ili Turki and Chagatay (the East Karluk languages) and slightly less closely to Uzbek (which is West Karluk).

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: It has vowel harmony like other _____ languages and has noun and verb cases but lacks distinction of gender forms
Uyghurs.fact: The modern Uyghur language is classified under the Karluk branch of the Turkic language family. It has vowel harmony like other Turkic languages and has noun and verb cases but lacks distinction of gender forms.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The Arabic script, known as the _____ alphabet, was adopted along with Islam
Uyghurs.fact: The Arabic script, called the Chagatay alphabet, was adopted along with Islam.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: This alphabet is known as _____ Yëziq (old script)
Uyghurs.fact: This alphabet is called Kona Yëziq (old script). Political changes in the 20th century led to numerous reforms of the scripts, for example the Cyrillic-based Uyghur Cyrillic alphabet, a Latin Uyghur New Script and later a reformed Uyghur Arabic alphabet, which represents all vowels, unlike Kona Yëziq.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A new Latin version, the _____ alphabet, was also devised in the 21st century
Uyghurs.fact: A new Latin version, the Uyghur Latin alphabet, was also devised in the 21st century.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Modern Uyghur religious literature includes the Taẕkirah, biographies of _____ religious figures and saints
Uyghurs.fact: Among these are Islamic religious texts and histories of Turkic peoples, and important works surviving from that era are Kutadgu Bilig, "Wisdom of Royal Glory" by Yusuf Khass Hajib (1069–70), Mahmud al-Kashgari's Dīwānu l-Luġat al-Turk, "A Dictionary of Turkic Dialects" (1072) and Ehmed Yükneki's Etebetulheqayiq. Modern Uyghur religious literature includes the Taẕkirah, biographies of Islamic religious figures and saints.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The Turki language _____ i Khwajagan was written by M. Sadiq Kashghari
Uyghurs.fact: The Turki language Tadhkirah i Khwajagan was written by M. Sadiq Kashghari.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Between the 1600s and 1900s many _____-language tazkirah manuscripts devoted to stories of local sultans, martyrs and saints were written
Uyghurs.fact: Among these are Islamic religious texts and histories of Turkic peoples, and important works surviving from that era are Kutadgu Bilig, "Wisdom of Royal Glory" by Yusuf Khass Hajib (1069–70), Mahmud al-Kashgari's Dīwānu l-Luġat al-Turk, "A Dictionary of Turkic Dialects" (1072) and Ehmed Yükneki's Etebetulheqayiq. The Turki language Tadhkirah i Khwajagan was written by M. Sadiq Kashghari.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Perhaps the most famous and best-loved pieces of modern Uyghur literature are Abdurehim Ötkür's Iz, _____, Zordun Sabir's Anayurt and Ziya Samedi's novels Mayimkhan and Mystery of the years
Uyghurs.fact: Perhaps the most famous and best-loved pieces of modern Uyghur literature are Abdurehim Ötkür's Iz, Oyghanghan Zimin, Zordun Sabir's Anayurt and Ziya Samedi's novels Mayimkhan and Mystery of the years.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Exiled Uyghur writers and poets, such as _____'ehed, use literature to highlight the issues facing their community
Uyghurs.fact: Exiled Uyghur writers and poets, such as Muyesser Abdul'ehed, use literature to highlight the issues facing their community.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Although the folk performers probably improvized their songs, as in _____ taksim performances, the present institutional canon is performed as fixed compositions by ensembles
Uyghurs.fact: Although the folk performers probably improvized their songs, as in Turkish taksim performances, the present institutional canon is performed as fixed compositions by ensembles.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The Uyghur Muqam of _____ has been designated by UNESCO as part of the Intangible Heritage of Humanity
Uyghurs.fact: Uyghurs have local muqam systems named after the oasis towns of Xinjiang, such as Dolan, Ili, Kumul and Turpan. The Uyghur Muqam of Xinjiang has been designated by UNESCO as part of the Intangible Heritage of Humanity.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Uzbek composer _____ uses themes from Uyghur folk music in her compositions
Uyghurs.fact: Uzbek composer Shakhida Shaimardanova uses themes from Uyghur folk music in her compositions.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Sama is a form of group dance for Newruz (_____) and other festivals
Uyghurs.fact: Sama is a form of group dance for Newruz (New Year) and other festivals.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Other dances include the Dolan dances, _____, and Nazirkom
Uyghurs.fact: Other dances include the Dolan dances, Shadiyane, and Nazirkom.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Some dances may alternate between singing and dancing, and _____ hand-drums called dap are commonly used as accompaniment for Uyghur dances
Uyghurs.fact: Some dances may alternate between singing and dancing, and Uyghur hand-drums called dap are commonly used as accompaniment for Uyghur dances.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Most have rectangular spaces with round arch ceilings often divided into four sections, each with a mural of _____
Uyghurs.fact: Most have rectangular spaces with round arch ceilings often divided into four sections, each with a mural of Buddha. The effect is of an entire ceiling covered with hundreds of Buddha murals.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The effect is of an entire ceiling covered with hundreds of _____ murals
Uyghurs.fact: Most have rectangular spaces with round arch ceilings often divided into four sections, each with a mural of Buddha. The effect is of an entire ceiling covered with hundreds of Buddha murals.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Some ceilings are painted with a large Buddha surrounded by other figures, including _____, Persians and Europeans
Uyghurs.fact: Some ceilings are painted with a large Buddha surrounded by other figures, including Indians, Persians and Europeans.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: They also introduced the written script for the _____ language
Uyghurs.fact: They also introduced the written script for the Mongolian language.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In the _____ era, education was provided by the mosques and madrassas
Uyghurs.fact: In the Islamic era, education was provided by the mosques and madrassas.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: During the Qing era, _____ schools were also set up in Xinjiang and in the late 19th century Christian missionary schools
Uyghurs.fact: During the Qing era, Chinese Confucian schools were also set up in Xinjiang and in the late 19th century Christian missionary schools.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In madrasas, poetry, logic, _____ grammar and Islamic law were taught
Uyghurs.fact: In madrasas, poetry, logic, Arabic grammar and Islamic law were taught. Although Islamic private schools (Sino-Arabic schools (中阿學校)) have been supported and permitted by the Chinese government in Hui Muslim areas since the 1980s, this policy does not extend to schools in Xinjiang due to fear of separatism.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In the early 20th century, the _____ from Russia spread new ideas on education and popularized the identity of "Turkestani"
Uyghurs.fact: In the early 20th century, the Jadidists Turkic Muslims from Russia spread new ideas on education and popularized the identity of "Turkestani".

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In more recent times, religious education is highly restricted in _____ and the Chinese authority had sought to eradicate any religious school they considered illegal
Uyghurs.fact: In more recent times, religious education is highly restricted in Xinjiang and the Chinese authority had sought to eradicate any religious school they considered illegal. Although Islamic private schools (Sino-Arabic schools (中阿學校)) have been supported and permitted by the Chinese government in Hui Muslim areas since the 1980s, this policy does not extend to schools in Xinjiang due to fear of separatism.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: However, from the mid-1980s onward, the _____ government began to reduce teaching in Uyghur and starting mid-1990s also began to merge some schools from the two systems
Uyghurs.fact: Early in the communist era, Uyghurs had a choice of two separate secular school systems, one conducted in their own language and one offering instructions only in Chinese. However, from the mid-1980s onward, the Chinese government began to reduce teaching in Uyghur and starting mid-1990s also began to merge some schools from the two systems.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: By _____, Xinjiang University, originally a bilingual institution, had ceased offering courses in the Uyghur language
Uyghurs.fact: By 2002, Xinjiang University, originally a bilingual institution, had ceased offering courses in the Uyghur language.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: By 2002, _____, originally a bilingual institution, had ceased offering courses in the Uyghur language
Uyghurs.fact: By 2002, Xinjiang University, originally a bilingual institution, had ceased offering courses in the Uyghur language.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: From _____ onward, the government policy has been that classes should be conducted in Chinese as much as possible and in some selected regions, instruction in Chinese began in the first grade
Uyghurs.fact: From 2004 onward, the government policy has been that classes should be conducted in Chinese as much as possible and in some selected regions, instruction in Chinese began in the first grade.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A special senior-secondary boarding school program for Uyghurs, the Xinjiang Class, with course work conducted entirely in Chinese was also established in _____
Uyghurs.fact: A special senior-secondary boarding school program for Uyghurs, the Xinjiang Class, with course work conducted entirely in Chinese was also set up in 2000.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Many schools also moved toward bilingual Chinese-Uyghur education from _____, with teaching in the Uyghur language limited to only a few hours a week
Uyghurs.fact: Many schools also moved toward bilingual Chinese-Uyghur education from 2012, with teaching in the Uyghur language limited to only a few hours a week.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Sir Percy Sykes described the medicine as "based on the ancient Greek theory" and mentioned how ailments and sicknesses were treated in _____ and Oases of Central Asia
Uyghurs.fact: Sir Percy Sykes described the medicine as "based on the ancient Greek theory" and mentioned how ailments and sicknesses were treated in Through Deserts and Oases of Central Asia.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Historically, _____ medical knowledge has contributed to Chinese medicine in terms of medical treatments, medicinal materials and ingredients and symptom detection
Uyghurs.fact: Modern Uyghur medical hospitals adopted modern medical science and medicine and applied evidence-based pharmaceutical technology to traditional medicines. Historically, Uyghur medical knowledge has contributed to Chinese medicine in terms of medical treatments, medicinal materials and ingredients and symptom detection.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A typical _____ dish is polu (or pilaf), a dish found throughout Central Asia
Uyghurs.fact: Modern Uyghur medical hospitals adopted modern medical science and medicine and applied evidence-based pharmaceutical technology to traditional medicines. Historically, Uyghur medical knowledge has contributed to Chinese medicine in terms of medical treatments, medicinal materials and ingredients and symptom detection.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In a common version of the _____ polu, carrots and mutton (or chicken) are first fried in oil with onions, then rice and water are added and the whole dish is steamed
Uyghurs.fact: Modern Uyghur medical hospitals adopted modern medical science and medicine and applied evidence-based pharmaceutical technology to traditional medicines. Historically, Uyghur medical knowledge has contributed to Chinese medicine in terms of medical treatments, medicinal materials and ingredients and symptom detection.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Kawaplar (_____: Каваплар) or chuanr (i.e., kebabs or grilled meat) are also found here
Uyghurs.fact: A typical Uyghur dish is polu (or pilaf), a dish found throughout Central Asia. In a common version of the Uyghur polu, carrots and mutton (or chicken) are first fried in oil with onions, then rice and water are added and the whole dish is steamed.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: This dish is likely to have originated from the _____ lamian, but its flavor and preparation method are distinctively Uyghur
Uyghurs.fact: Another common Uyghur dish is leghmen (لەغمەن, ләғмән), a noodle dish with a stir-fried topping (säy, from Chinese cai, 菜) usually made from mutton and vegetables, such as tomatoes, onions, green bell peppers, chili peppers and cabbage. This dish is likely to have originated from the Chinese lamian, but its flavor and preparation method are distinctively Uyghur.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A _____-style breakfast consists of tea with home-baked bread, hardened yogurt, olives, honey, raisins and almonds
Uyghurs.fact: Another common Uyghur dish is leghmen (لەغمەن, ләғмән), a noodle dish with a stir-fried topping (säy, from Chinese cai, 菜) usually made from mutton and vegetables, such as tomatoes, onions, green bell peppers, chili peppers and cabbage. This dish is likely to have originated from the Chinese lamian, but its flavor and preparation method are distinctively Uyghur.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Uyghur food (_____, Уйғур Йәмәклири) is characterized by mutton, beef, camel (solely bactrian), chicken, goose, carrots, tomatoes, onions, peppers, eggplant, celery, various dairy foods and fruits
Uyghurs.fact: Uyghur food (Uyghur Yemekliri, Уйғур Йәмәклири) is characterized by mutton, beef, camel (solely bactrian), chicken, goose, carrots, tomatoes, onions, peppers, eggplant, celery, various dairy foods and fruits.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Other dishes include _____ (Тоғач) (a type of tandoor bread) and Tunurkawab (Тунуркаваб)
Uyghurs.fact: Other dishes include Toghach (Тоғач) (a type of tandoor bread) and Tunurkawab (Тунуркаваб).

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Sir Aurel Stein observed that the "_____, accustomed to shelter this shaven head under a substantial fur-cap when the temperature is so low as it was just then"
Uyghurs.fact: Sir Aurel Stein observed that the "Turki Muhammadan, accustomed to shelter this shaven head under a substantial fur-cap when the temperature is so low as it was just then".

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Uyghur artisan craftsmen in _____ are known for their knife manufacture
Uyghurs.fact: Uyghur artisan craftsmen in Yengisar are known for their knife manufacture.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: A few of the well-known agricultural goods include apples (especially from _____), sweet melons (from Hami), and grapes from Turpan
Uyghurs.fact: A few of the well-known agricultural goods include apples (especially from Ghulja), sweet melons (from Hami), and grapes from Turpan.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The general lack of _____ proficiency in Mandarin Chinese also creates a barrier to access private and public sector jobs
Uyghurs.fact: Local handicrafts like rug-weaving and jade-carving are also important to the cottage industry of the Uyghurs. Some Uyghurs have been given jobs through Chinese government affirmative action programs.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Others use names with hard-to-understand etymologies, with the majority dating from the _____ era and being of Arabic or Persian derivation
Uyghurs.fact: Others use names with hard-to-understand etymologies, with the majority dating from the Islamic era and being of Arabic or Persian derivation. Some pre-Islamic Uyghur names are preserved in Turpan and Qumul.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The government has banned some two dozen _____ names
Uyghurs.fact: Others use names with hard-to-understand etymologies, with the majority dating from the Islamic era and being of Arabic or Persian derivation. Some pre-Islamic Uyghur names are preserved in Turpan and Qumul.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Some pre-_____ names are preserved in Turpan and Qumul
Uyghurs.fact: Some pre-Islamic Uyghur names are preserved in Turpan and Qumul.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Historians generally agree that the adoption of the term "Uyghur" is based on a decision from a 1921 conference in Tashkent, attended by _____ from the Tarim Basin (Xinjiang)
Uyghurs.fact: Laura J Newby says the sedentary Altishahri Turkic people considered themselves separate from other Turkic Muslims since at least the 19th century. The name "Uyghur" reappeared after the Soviet Union took the 9th-century ethnonym from the Uyghur Khaganate, then reapplied it to all non-nomadic Turkic Muslims of Xinjiang.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Use of the term _____ was unknown in Xinjiang until 1934
Uyghurs.fact: Use of the term Uyghur was unknown in Xinjiang until 1934. The area governor, Sheng Shicai, came to power, adopting the Soviet ethnographic classification instead of the Kuomintang's and became the first to promulgate the official use of the term "Uyghur" to describe the Turkic Muslims of Xinjiang.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The authors also cite anthropologic studies which also estimate about 30% "_____ proportions", which are in agreement with their genetic results
Uyghurs.fact: The authors also cite anthropologic studies which also estimate about 30% "Western proportions", which are in agreement with their genetic results.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Ganzhou was absorbed by the _____ in 1036
Uyghurs.fact: Ganzhou was absorbed by the Western Xia in 1036.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The 12th and 13th century saw the domination by non-Muslim powers: first the Kara-_____ in the 12th century, followed by the Mongols in the 13th century
Uyghurs.fact: The 12th and 13th century saw the domination by non-Muslim powers: first the Kara-Khitans in the 12th century, followed by the Mongols in the 13th century.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: This led the _____ to capitalize on the Uyghur and other Turkic people's discontent in the region, culminating in their support of the Ili Rebellion in October 1944
Uyghurs.fact: The Soviets backed Chinese warlord Sheng Shicai's rule over East Turkestan/Xinjiang from 1934 to 1943. This led the Soviets to capitalize on the Uyghur and other Turkic people's discontent in the region, culminating in their support of the Ili Rebellion in October 1944.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The Ili Rebellion resulted in the establishment of the Second East Turkestan Republic on _____ November 1944, in the three districts of what is now the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture
Uyghurs.fact: The Ili Rebellion resulted in the establishment of the Second East Turkestan Republic on 12 November 1944, in the three districts of what is now the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: In the summer of 1949, the _____ purged the thirty top leaders of the Second East Turkestan Republic and its five top officials died in a mysterious plane crash on 27 August 1949
Uyghurs.fact: This led the Soviets to capitalize on the Uyghur and other Turkic people's discontent in the region, culminating in their support of the Ili Rebellion in October 1944. In the summer of 1949, the Soviets purged the thirty top leaders of the Second East Turkestan Republic and its five top officials died in a mysterious plane crash on 27 August 1949.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: On _____ October 1949, the People's Liberation Army entered the region and the East Turkestan National Army was merged into the PLA's 5th Army Corps, leading to the official end of the Second East Tur
Uyghurs.fact: On 13 October 1949, the People's Liberation Army entered the region and the East Turkestan National Army was merged into the PLA's 5th Army Corps, leading to the official end of the Second East Turkestan Republic on 22 December 1949.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: There had been _____ conversions in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, but these were suppressed by the First East Turkestan Republic government agents
Uyghurs.fact: There had been Christian conversions in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, but these were suppressed by the First East Turkestan Republic government agents. According to the national census, 0.5% or 1,142 Uyghurs in Kazakhstan were Christians in 2009.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: From 2004 onward, the government policy has been that classes should be conducted in _____ as much as possible and in some selected regions, instruction in Chinese began in the first grade
Uyghurs.fact: However, from the mid-1980s onward, the Chinese government began to reduce teaching in Uyghur and starting mid-1990s also began to merge some schools from the two systems. From 2004 onward, the government policy has been that classes should be conducted in Chinese as much as possible and in some selected regions, instruction in Chinese began in the first grade.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: Many schools also moved toward bilingual _____-Uyghur education from 2012, with teaching in the Uyghur language limited to only a few hours a week
Uyghurs.fact: From 2004 onward, the government policy has been that classes should be conducted in Chinese as much as possible and in some selected regions, instruction in Chinese began in the first grade. A special senior-secondary boarding school program for Uyghurs, the Xinjiang Class, with course work conducted entirely in Chinese was also set up in 2000.

Uyghurs.subject: Indian Languages
Uyghurs.question: The Ili Rebellion resulted in the establishment of the _____ on 12 November 1944, in the three districts of what is now the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture
Uyghurs.fact: The Ili Rebellion resulted in the establishment of the Second East Turkestan Republic on 12 November 1944, in the three districts of what is now the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture. Several pro-KMT Uyghurs like Isa Yusuf Alptekin, Memet Emin Bugra, and Mesut Sabri opposed the Second East Turkestan Republic and supported the Republic of China.

Valle de los Ingenios.answer: a series of three interconnected valleys about 12 kilometres (7.5 mi) outside of Trinidad, Cuba. In 1988, Valle de los I
Valle de los Ingenios.fact: Valle de los Ingenios, also named Valley de los Ingenios or Valley of the Sugar Mills, is a series of three interconnected valleys about 12 kilometres (7.5 mi) outside of Trinidad, Cuba. Valle de los Ingenios.question: In _____, Valle de los Ingenios and neighbouring Trinidad were declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO, because of its testimony to the early sugar trade industry
Valle de los Ingenios.fact: In 1988, Valle de los Ingenios and neighbouring Trinidad were declared a World Heritage Site by UNESCO, because of its testimony to the early sugar trade industry.

Valle de los Ingenios.subject: Indian Languages
Valle de los Ingenios.question: The valleys are provided with water by several rivers, among them the _____, Rio Caracusey, Rio de Ay, and Rio Tayaba
Valle de los Ingenios.fact: The valleys are provided with water by several rivers, among them the Agabama River, Rio Caracusey, Rio de Ay, and Rio Tayaba.

Valle de los Ingenios.subject: Indian Languages
Valle de los Ingenios.question: Although the barracones are now used as housing and are in poor repair, the house (which has been converted into a restaurant) and the "_____" are well maintained
Valle de los Ingenios.fact: Although the barracones are now used as housing and are in poor repair, the house (which has been converted into a restaurant) and the "Iznaga Tower" are well maintained.

Valle de los Ingenios.subject: Indian Languages

Valle de los Ingenios.fact: The 45 metre (147 ft) tower was constructed sometime in 1816 by the owner, Alejo Maria Iznaga y Borrell.
